theme: Back-to-Business Season: Turn Q4 Planning Into a Competitive Advantage

linkedin.text:
Every September, the same pattern plays out across our client roster — and after 16 years and 1,500+ events, we read it clearly.

The HR and sales leaders who treat September as a planning sprint — not a recovery month — consistently run better year-end events. Here's the simple reason: venue availability, creative quality, and budget efficiency all degrade as you move closer to December.

The companies who brief us in September on their Q4 conference, incentive trip, or gala dinner get:
• Access to the venues and destinations that actually fit their brief
• Time to build a program with real impact — not just logistics
• A team that arrives at the event energized, not exhausted by a rushed build-up

If your year-end event is still a line item on a to-do list, this is the week to move it to a brief. Happy to share what's available and what's working. DM me directly.
